title: Arrears Margin on the Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Interest Rate
content:
**Collections pricing schedule.** Arrears add a margin to the annual rate of monthly interest on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion, counting the scheduled payments behind on the posting day as the statement periods already carrying a monthly-interest entry, less the months deferred under hardship deferrals, minus the whole scheduled payments covered: two or more behind adds the two-behind margin of 2.00%; exactly one behind adds the one-behind margin of 0.50%; none behind adds nothing. An account paid ahead of its schedule counts as no scheduled payments behind.

## Counting payments behind

- Statement periods already carrying a monthly-interest entry: those on the account before the interest being posted.
- Months deferred under hardship deferrals: the total months of every hardship deferral on the account.
- Whole scheduled payments covered: scheduled-payment entries net of returned payments, divided by the scheduled monthly payment (the plan's payment factor per 1,000.00 times the financed amount, rounded to the cent and at least the plan's minimum monthly payment) and rounded down to a whole number.
- An account paid ahead of its schedule, where the whole payments covered exceed the periods counted, counts as none behind.

| Scheduled payments behind on the posting day | Margin added to the purchase APR |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2.00% |
| Exactly 1 | 0.50% |
| None | Nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

| Periods with a monthly-interest entry | Months deferred | Whole payments covered | Behind | Margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 0 | 12 | 2 | 2.00% |
| 14 | 2 | 12 | 0 | Nothing |
| 10 | 0 | 9 | 1 | 0.50% |
| 10 | 0 | 11 | None (paid ahead) | Nothing |
